content:
One vote changed everything in Rajasthan’s local body polls. Independent candidate Jagdish Prasad won Ward No. 6 by the narrowest possible margin, defeating BJP’s Ramsharan 151-150, proving that every single vote can shape an election’s outcome.

The result became even more emotional because Jagdish Prasad’s mother passed away a day after casting her vote. With just one ballot separating victory and defeat, her final vote became a deeply personal part of the family’s story and one of the most unforgettable moments from the election.
